extension.news: [B]New[/B][CR]- add support for Kodi v22 (Piers)[CR]- add Dolby Vision profile to the HDR media flag[CR]- add extra title info, parental rating and backend name to PVR items[CR]- add live bitrates, queue levels and subtitle decoder to the player process info dialog[CR]- add spinner to the weather widget while it updates[CR]- add last update time to the weather window[CR][CR][B]Improved[/B][CR]- allow stepping through subtitles in both directions in the video OSD[CR]- open the subtitle settings from the subtitle name in the video OSD[CR]- name audio and subtitle streams by their stream name in the video OSD and fullscreen info[CR]- detect Dolby Atmos and DTS:X from the stream instead of the file name[CR]- separate genres, directors and writers with commas[CR]- hide duration based information during live playback[CR]- consolidate codec and audio channel labels into shared lookup maps[CR][CR][B]Fixed[/B][CR]- fix audio channel labels claiming layouts a channel count cannot identify
